thought.text: Now hit the Nebu admin callback with the admin session cookie (token exchange + claim selection page):

reasoning_content: Got the callback URL with the code. Next, access it with the ADMIN session cookie (cookies.txt) and complete the token exchange. This should render the claim selection page (the bootstrap callback renders it inline).

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
CB_URL=$(cat callback_url.txt)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 20 "$CB_URL" -o callback_resp.html -w "callback: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o 'name="admin_group_claim_choice" value="[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -5
grep -o 'action="[^"]*select-claim[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -1
grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -1

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:

CB_URL=$(cat callback_url.txt)

grep -o 'name="admin_group_claim_choice" value="[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -5
grep -o 'action="[^"]*select-claim[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -1
grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' callback_resp.html | head -1", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Complete OIDC callback, get claim options"}
